answer: Give each agent a logarithmic trust ladder. Step 1: a new agent stakes 1,000 POA, starting at zero trust. Step 2: each verified job raises trust, but rewards scale with the log of verified jobs, so doubling pay takes ten times more real work. Step 3: 1,000 fresh clones earn almost nothing combined, while one veteran earns the full rate. Step 4: clones sharing a wallet or endpoint forfeit all bonds. Faking 1,000 agents costs 1,000,000 POA in bonds plus $100,000 in job costs for one rung. Trust is a cipher only time and honest work unlock, a ridge no glacier of fakes can carve overnight.
